jobs.title: Project Manager - Antwerpen
jobs.description:
Job Requirements

Position Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for managing the installation of medical imaging systems (MRI scanners, CT scanners, etc.) and their integration into the hospital environment, including the coordination of finishing works.

As Project Manager, you will guide, manage and motivate the project team throughout the entire project lifecycle, from project development through to effective implementation. Customer satisfaction is at the heart of the entire process, up to and including the final handover of the project.

Key Responsibilities 

You analyse project requirements, technical drawings, specifications of Siemens Healthineers medical systems, construction specifications and contractual conditions in order to assess the technical feasibility of the project and respond to our customers' tenders with a technical proposal.
You actively contribute to the development of the project and select reliable subcontractors for the execution of special construction works and building services (including structural works, electrical installations, lighting, HVAC, finishing works, medical gases, …) enabling the installation of Siemens Healthineers medical equipment.
You work closely with our drafting team to ensure the accurate preparation of AutoCAD drawings.
You supervise project execution and the implementation plan and ensure that the project team delivers the project efficiently.
Together with the subcontractors, you identify the best technical solutions for issues arising on site.
You closely monitor cost development against the defined financial targets.
You manage the contract, change requests, claims and deviations from the original order.
You manage all required documentation, such as the as-built documentation, technical documents and documentation relating to provisional acceptance.
You work closely with the customer (including technical, biomedical and safety departments) as well as with all other relevant internal stakeholders (such as Purchasing, Quotation/Proposal Management, Technical Services and Sales). You also support fellow Project Managers in neighbouring regions when required.
You comply with all Siemens Healthineers compliance requirements and codes of conduct.

Work Experience

You hold an engineering degree (electrical engineering, electromechanics, construction engineering or a related field), or have equivalent professional experience.
You have at least three years of experience as a Project Manager. However, we are also open to junior profiles with strong motivation and a high learning curve.
You have an excellent command of Dutch, both spoken and written, combined with a good command of French and English.
You demonstrate an entrepreneurial mindset and take initiative.
You are results- and quality-oriented.
You have excellent communication skills.
Experience or knowledge of the hospital environment is an asset.

Benefits

Compensation, Pension & Benefits: Competitive salary package, company car, meal vouchers, pension plan and diverse employee benefits (discounts, internet).
Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health coverage, complemented by wellbeing programs and Employee Assistance Program.
Learning, Development & Recognition: Continuous learning opportunities, training programs and career development, with recognition initiatives that celebrate employee contributions.
Work-Life Balance & Community Engagement: Flexible working arrangements and additional leave days, along with opportunities to volunteer and support community initiatives.

Company Description
ANR Business Consulting provides smart, reliable offshore support that helps organizations scale faster and operate more efficiently. The company specializes in recruitment support, virtual assistants, accounting, digital marketing, and IT solutions tailored to diverse business needs. The ERP Project Manager is responsible for planning, leading, and delivering end-to-end ERP implementation projects for ANR Business Consulting’s clients. Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex business data and requirements.
Hands-on experience with ERP implementations and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.
Proficiency in budgeting, cost control, and financial oversight for technology projects.
Deep understanding of business process analysis, optimization, and documentation.
Experience managing full project lifecycles, including planning, execution, and post-go-live support.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills in a remote environment.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate with external vendors or partners.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; relevant ERP or project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) are an advantage.
Comfort working across time zones and managing multiple projects or priorities simultaneously.

jobs.title: Principal Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse’s mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace.

About The Role

As Principal Project Manager, you will be a project expert responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing all aspects of supply chain projects to ensure delivery within scope and budget. You are the primary point of accountability for project success and coordinating teams within the Enterprise Supply Chain (ESC) Category Management Center of Excellence.

You will report to the Supply Chain Spend Management Supervisor, within the Enterprise Supply Chain (ESC) Category Management Center of Excellence .

This is a remote position.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Change Management

Define scope, objectives, milestones, and success criteria; build integrated project plans (charter, WBS, schedule, RAIL log, Risk Register).
Lead complex cross-functional projects from assessment through implementation, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned initiatives and ensuring objectives, timelines, deliverables, risks, actions, and stakeholder expectations are clearly managed.
Use process reviews, partner feedback, and operational reporting to identify process gaps, root causes, initiative needs, and opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and results.
Develop current-state and future-state process documentation, project plans, action trackers, and standardized best practices to support sustainable improvement.
Present executive-ready updates including project status, key milestones, risks, decisions needed, financial or operational impacts, and recommended next steps.
Facilitate project governance through weekly standups, monthly steering reviews, and gate approvals.
Drive change management activities, including stakeholder alignment, communication planning, training, adoption tracking, reinforcement of new processes or tools, and clear messaging to impacted teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Category Management, Procurement, SIOP, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, APX, Logistics, Finance, IT, and our teams to understand requirements, align priorities, and drive improvement initiatives.
Facilitate meetings, lead working sessions, and deliver executive-level presentations to align partners, communicate recommendations, summarize progress, and drive project execution.
Bridge project teams, business stakeholders, and leadership by consolidating feedback, escalating issues, documenting decisions, and maintaining throughout the project lifecycle.
Support system enhancements, process automation, and report improvements across departments.

Reporting & Business Support

Translate business findings into clear insights, recommendations, and presentation-ready materials that support decision-making and stakeholder adoption.
Review operational and financial information from multiple systems and sources to identify trends, risks, performance gaps, and new initiative opportunities.
Develop and maintain ad hoc reports, recurring project updates, executive summaries, and presentation materials for leadership, executive teams, and partners.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in an engineering field, supply chain, project management, finance, or a related field; Master's degree preferred; equivalent related experience may be considered.
8+ years of experience in project management, business process improvement, change management with 2+ years leading supply chain projects.
Experience driving change management efforts, managing scope, schedule, and project budget across multiple sites/functions.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams, identifying risks, and driving enterprise-wide programs.
Experience working with Category Management, Supply Chain, Operations teams, Finance, internal or external partners.
Continuous improvement mindset and experience with process optimization.
Professional certifications such as PMP, Scrum Master, Lean or similar project certifications (in process or willing to get).

Westinghouse is committed to transparency and equity in all people practices. The base salary range for this position, which is dependent upon experience, qualifications and skills, is estimated to be $103,300 to $129,000 per year.

Why Westinghouse?

Benefits

Our benefits package is tailored to meet the diverse needs of our employees, while also promoting wellness and career growth. The following are representative of what we offer:

Comprehensive Medical benefits which could include medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage and Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions options
Wellness Programs designed to support employees in maintaining their health and well-being including Employee Assistance Program providing support for our employees and their household members
401(k) with Company Match Contributions to support employees' retirement
Paid Vacations and Company Holidays
Opportunities for Flexible Work Arrangements to promote work-life balance
Educational Reimbursement and Comprehensive Career Programs to help employees grow in their careers
Global Recognition and Service Programs to celebrate employee accomplishments and service
Employee Referral Program

Safety and Quality

Technical Project Manager - Delivery

(Remote, Costa Rica)

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven group of 29,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers in more than 30 countries. Our entrepreneurial teams are empowered to innovate, act nimbly, and create a lasting and sustainable impact for our clients, their customers, and the communities in which we live.

The ideal candidate should have a strong track record of managing complex initiatives, driving cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, and budget.

Experience working with enterprise customers in consulting, digital agencies, or software companies.

Experience with Agile methodologies and cross-functional product development.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Technical Program Management Team

The Technical Program Management team at Affirm operates at the intersection of strategy, product, and engineering execution. We are versatile operators and trusted strategic partners who drive complex initiatives, design our planning engines, and architect operational frameworks that power the technology behind Affirm's business. Guided by our commitment to putting the customer first and pushing the envelope, we elevate how teams collaborate, resolve critical tradeoffs, and turn high-level vision into scalable reality.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility planning programs for our teams and help streamline our processes for building and delivering great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our business and technology process management practices need to scale with it. Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible transformation & operational programs in service of our team’s mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives
Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across the company to drive alignment on strategy, priorities, and key decisions.
Implement lean processes and drive towards better ways of working to realize value from planning, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and build a culture of continuous iteration and improvement
Establish and run data-driven operational frameworks to view portfolio performance against OKRs, accelerate value realization by enabling right investment decisions, influence and train teams on more effective ways of working, and create excitement around change to increase adoption
Develop communication strategies to ensure critical information flows seamlessly across the organization
Partner with cross-functional teams to plan change requirements, identify risks, manage dependencies, and establish tools and forums to drive clarity and efficiency
Identify and distill needs, experiment with new ideas to address systemic inefficiencies and bring transparency, visibility, alignment, and promote accountability across the organization

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8 years of proven experience managing programs, processes, and change management in a technology-focused environment

Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams

Strong stakeholder management with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams

jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to join our Ads TPM team within the Tech PMO (Technical Program Management Office), supporting the Ads Product & Engineering organization. As a TPM, you will lead your team in driving cross-functional initiatives that span multiple technical teams. In this role, you'll own and drive technical programs in the Ads Monetization engineering space, many of which will require you to work cross-functionally across multiple engineering teams at Reddit. You'll partner with engineering leaders across the company to evaluate prioritization, tradeoffs and risks related to the programs you own.

Who we are:

The Technical Program Management Office
(Tech PMO) exists to accelerate , scale , and empower all teams at Reddit to do their best work and advance our company's mission. We operate from within the office of the CTO, maximizing our ability to galvanize and drive technical programs and solutions to solve company-wide problems. We drive operational excellence within the organizations we partner with and our reach extends across the entire company.

At Reddit, Technical Program Managers
use technical judgment to define and drive large programs across multiple engineering teams. They are a welcome partner to engineering leaders in project discussions impacting planning and execution. They engage with engineering staff in determining root causes, identifying and selecting alternative solutions, and using their technical expertise to understand the effects, impacts, and risks of a solution. Above and beyond program-level impact, they build execution processes and reduce inefficiencies to build overall scale.

What you'll do:

High-quality technical program management is a distinct and high-value skillset, and while the roles generally don't involve direct management, they are a part of the organizational leadership. In this role, you will:

Get Things Done
. More than just displaying activity, counting sprint points, or delivering regular updates. You actually bring projects to completion, deliver real accomplishments for the business, and help your teams understand the difference.
Dive into Details
. You understand the details of their projects and help guide them with and in active partnership with their teams. You don't just stay in the stratosphere or in an abstract process. You have the technical judgment to act as a partner with your teams in planning and decision-making.
Make Work Repeatable
. You create and improve processes that smooth the path for others and prevent and remove recurring organizational toil (and the lower quality bar that often allows). You reuse processes developed elsewhere, and aid in the adoption of standards where relevant.
Mentor & Lead
. You are good at, and enjoy, informally aiding others in developing key organizational and project skills. You're a leader within your projects and support people in the process.
Bring Order out of Chaos.
You are known for leaving a program and the teams you support in a position of stronger organization than where they started, and those teams continue to succeed even when you are no longer specifically engaged in the project.

What We Can Expect From You:

8+ years of collective experience in engineering and program management roles, with at least 4 years focused on digital ads platforms or ads monetization.
Strong communication and influencing skills.
A team player mentality with the ability to work collaboratively across all levels of the organization.
Proactive and curious by nature. You are creative and enjoy taking unique approaches to solve problems.
Pragmatic; you take an iterative approach to developing processes and systems
Technical depth and judgment.
Analytical problem-solving experience with large-scale systems.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Cleared
jobs.description:
About Aalyria

Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.

Role Overview

Aalyria's Spacetime platform orchestrates highly dynamic aerospace networks using a temporospatial Software Defined Networking (SDN) approach, managing not just routing but the physical link topology and lower-layer configuration underneath it.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to own execution on one of our most sensitive customer programs, work that requires an active TS/SCI clearance

, with a polygraph strongly preferred given the access levels involved. You'll be the linchpin between Aalyria's engineering teams and a cleared government customer, driving technical tradeoffs directly rather than simply tracking them. Engineering will look to you to make sequencing, scope, and architecture-adjacent calls, and to represent program status and risk with complete accuracy to customer stakeholders who may not always have full visibility into every technical detail.

This is a role for someone who can operate independently inside a classified environment, hold their own in a room with Staff or Principal engineers, and get things done through influence rather than authority.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technical Program Execution: Own program planning and execution for a classified Spacetime engineering effort, driving the work through each phase of the mission and directly resolving cross-system dependencies and technical tradeoffs, not just surfacing them for others to decide.
Cleared Customer & Stakeholder Leadership: Serve as the primary programmatic interface with a cleared government customer, communicating fluently with both technical staff and senior government stakeholders across classified and unclassified channels.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Run the operating rhythm, such as kickoffs, technical reviews, exec readouts, that keeps Engineering, Product, and Solutions Engineering aligned on status, risk, and decisions across compartmented and uncompartmented workstreams.
Requirements Translation & Technical Judgment: Translate customer and mission requirements into actionable engineering plans. You should be able to read and critique a design document unaided, and reason in real time about latency, throughput, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs.
Security & Compliance Stewardship: Handle classified information and CUI correctly as a matter of course, maintain a sound personal security posture, and follow program security and export-control (ITAR/EAR) requirements without needing to be reminded. Partner closely with the FSO and IT/Cybersecurity, who are direct stakeholders in how this role is evaluated.
Contract & Financial Management: Own T&M or cost-type contract reporting requirements, including monthly labor, subcontract, hardware, and materials tracking at the Master Equipment List (MEL) level to support invoicing.
Risk & Delivery Coordination: Identify schedule, scope, and dependency risk early; escalate with context; and coordinate mitigations directly with engineering leads across development, staging, and dedicated government cloud production environments.

Required Qualifications

Active TS/SCI clearance in good standing. TS/SCI with polygraph is strongly preferred given the access levels this role requires.
5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related role delivering complex technical platforms, ideally for U.S. Government or defense/space customers.
Demonstrated technical depth: the ability to read and critique a design document unaided, and to engage engineering teams on architecture, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs as a peer, not a translator.
A track record with genuinely technical programs, infrastructure migrations, API/interface contracts, cross-system dependency resolution, or multi-team technical rollouts, not just cross-functional coordination with a technical flavor.
Proven ability to influence without authority and interface confidently with senior government and customer stakeholders.
Experience managing complex project financials, resource tracking, or strict contractual reporting requirements (T&M, FFP, or cost-type contracts).
U.S. citizenship (required to hold and maintain the clearance level above).
Background in engineering, hardware/software systems, or solutions architecture, or a related field with hands-on experience running technical programs alongside engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with networking, telecom, or SDN/traffic engineering concepts.
Strong background in satellite and mission operations — early-orbit commissioning, fleet readiness, or operating in high-consequence environments.
Experience supporting programs that have transitioned from prototype to production volumes, and improving TRL/MRL along the way.
In-depth knowledge of USG acquisition processes, FAR/DFARS, and contract vehicles (BAAs, sole-source, IDIQs, OTAs).
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field — preferred, not mandatory. Equivalent hands-on technical experience is evaluated on equal footing.
Willingness to travel occasionally as program needs require.

Compensation

The base salary for this role is $187,000 – $207,000, which may vary by geographic location. Compensation also includes a competitive equity grant, an annual performance bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package. Your final offer will reflect your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

What We Offer

Innovative Environment: Work at a cutting-edge company shaping the future of aerospace communications.
Impactful Work: Directly contribute to critical national security programs and initiatives.
Growth Opportunities: Expand your career with opportunities for professional development and advancement.
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive workplace where your contributions matter.

Drive Global Transformation at Wahl Clipper

At Wahl Clipper, innovation doesn't stop at our products, it powers the way we work across the globe. As a trusted leader in grooming and personal care for over 100 years, we're investing in digital transformation that enhances efficiency, strengthens our global operations, and creates exceptional experiences for our teams and customers. We're looking for a Global Digital Program Manager who thrives on turning strategy into action. In this role, you'll lead large-scale, cross-functional digital initiatives that impact teams around the world. If you excel at bringing people together, managing complexity, and delivering results that drive business value, we'd love to meet you.

This role can be based in either the US or Europe.

What You'll Do

You'll serve as the driving force behind key global digital programs, ensuring projects are delivered successfully while aligning business goals, technology solutions, and stakeholder expectations. Your day-to-day will include:

Leads all aspects of the program and/or project lifecycle - planning, scope definition, budgeting, staffing, design, execution, and delivery - coordinating work activities across multiple project managers and functions to meet evolving business needs.
Accountable for project results along with the project sponsor; drives on-time, on-budget, on-scope delivery of capabilities that are adopted by the business and generate measurable improvements in performance, efficiency, and profitability.
Partners with the Global Digital Technology team to receive and validate business and functional requirements, ensuring regional inputs are fully reconciled and translated into actionable project scope prior to execution.
Collaborates with Global stakeholders – as the primary point of contact for Digital Technology Programs/Projects managing expectations, inspiring confidence, enabling informed decision-making, and keeping all parties aligned on priorities and progress.
Prepares the project work plan, roadmap, initial release plan, and migration strategy; tracks milestones, KPIs, and budgetary performance, reporting findings regularly to senior and executive management.
Manages issues, risks, and change proactively using formal techniques for identification, mitigation, and resolution; preserves business plan commitments while negotiating timing, cost, quality, and resources as conditions evolve.
Coordinates with the Global Digital Technology team to ensure business-to-technical requirements are accurately translated for delivery teams; supports UAT governance and facilitates regional sign-off against defined acceptance criteria.
Evaluates the business impact of proposed changes and technology decisions in partnership with the Global Digital Technology team; contributes to business cases and ROI analyses to support leadership decision-making.
Facilitates steering committee sessions. Communicates, resolves and escalates issues in a timely fashion and arbitrates cross-functional conflicts to maintain program momentum.
Follows enterprise program management practices, processes, and delivery metrics.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree and 5 years of experience.
Demonstrated track record of managing the successful delivery of multiple complex projects with formal project controls for scope, schedule, and budget.
Proficiency with project management methodologies, tools, and processes.
Ability to structure and manage multiple work streams with empowered work stream leaders.
Experience managing the unique challenges of product launch, platform rollout, or multi-site implementation projects.
Strong influential leadership skills with the ability to identify and solve problems effectively through listening and influencing without direct authority.
Strong executive-level verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal skills, positive attitude, and ability to engage and create trust with others to build and foster cross-functional team relationships.
Strong decision-making skills and organization skills with ability to multitask.
Works with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications:

PMP Certification

Why You'll Love Wahl Clipper

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth, including:

Low-cost BCBSIL medical, dental, and vision plans
A generous company-matched 401(k) and profit sharing
Tuition support to fuel your learning
Paid holidays and a vibrant, casual work environment

But that's just the beginning. At Wahl, you'll also enjoy:

A legacy of quality and innovation.
A team that values your expertise and ideas.
Opportunities to grow and contribute to meaningful projects.
A culture built on respect, precision, and progress.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're passionate about leading strategic initiatives, connecting people and technology, and delivering results that matter, apply today and help shape the future of Wahl Clipper's global digital journey.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Technical Program Management Team

The Technical Program Management team at Affirm operates at the intersection of strategy, product, and engineering execution. We are versatile operators and trusted strategic partners who drive complex initiatives, design our planning engines, and architect operational frameworks that power the technology behind Affirm's business. Guided by our commitment to putting the customer first and pushing the envelope, we elevate how teams collaborate, resolve critical tradeoffs, and turn high-level vision into scalable reality.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility planning programs for our teams and help streamline our processes for building and delivering great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our business and technology process management practices need to scale with it. In this role, you will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to align efforts with goals, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive change initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible transformation & operational programs in service of our team’s mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives
Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across the company to drive alignment on strategy, priorities, and key decisions.
Implement lean processes and drive towards better ways of working to realize value from planning, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and build a culture of continuous iteration and improvement
Establish and run data-driven operational frameworks to view portfolio performance against OKRs, accelerate value realization by enabling right investment decisions, influence and train teams on more effective ways of working, and create excitement around change to increase adoption
Develop communication strategies to ensure critical information flows seamlessly across the organization
Partner with cross-functional teams to plan change requirements, identify risks, manage dependencies, and establish tools and forums to drive clarity and efficiency
Identify and distill needs, experiment with new ideas to address systemic inefficiencies and bring transparency, visibility, alignment, and promote accountability across the organization

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8 years of proven experience managing programs, processes, and change management in a technology-focused environment
Strong technical background with a deep understanding of software development processes
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to make tradeoff decisions
Strong stakeholder management with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams
Track record of successfully implementing frameworks at scale and building relationships in a remote friendly culture
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and consulting skills
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better
Prior experience in FinTech, Payments or Commerce is a plus.

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $128,000- $188,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Hyperscale Customer Program Manager 4
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

This is a senior, high-visibility role at the heart of Equinix’s most strategic growth engine. As a Hyperscale Customer Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of large, complex xScale deployments for some of the world’s largest cloud and AI customers, spanning multiple sites, regions and internal teams. You will be the single point of accountability for the customer programme: from contract handover and design, through construction and commissioning, to acceptance, billing and close-out. You will operate with significant autonomy, engage at executive level with customers and internal leadership, and help shape how Equinix delivers at hyperscale.

Responsibilities

Program Delivery & Execution

Lead large-scale, cross-functional, multi-site and cross-regional customer deployments from contract handover through to acceptance and closure.
Own the integrated programme schedule, deployment plans and lifecycle milestones, aligning design, construction, commissioning and ready-for-service dates.
Translate contract commitments (lease terms, technical specifications, delivery dates and SLAs) into a clear, baselined delivery plan.
Track critical-path dependencies such as permits, utility power, long-lead equipment and customer fit-out, and drive mitigation plans.
Identify, manage and mitigate delivery risks and in-flight changes, communicating impact clearly and early to customers and internal stakeholders.

Commercial & Financial Management

Manage the change order process end to end: scope, impact assessment, pricing input, approval and contract alignment.
Track billing and rent commencement milestones so revenue is recognised on time and invoicing is accurate.
Support book-to-bill and backlog reporting with accurate forecast dates and delivery status.
Protect Equinix’s commercial position by ensuring work only proceeds against agreed scope and approved changes.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary customer interface throughout delivery, maintaining an executive-level presence and trusted-advisor relationship.
Run the programme governance rhythm: weekly delivery calls, monthly approval committees and executive reviews covering progress, risks, decisions and milestones.
Produce clear, concise executive reporting, including status dashboards, risk registers, issue notices and close-out documentation.
Build lasting relationships with customer stakeholders across construction, operations, procurement and leadership.

Escalations & Issue Resolution

Independently manage standard and mid-level escalations; partner with senior leadership on complex or contractual issues.
Drive resolution with professionalism and persistence, holding internal teams and vendors accountable for commitments and outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Coordinate across Sales, Legal, Design & Construction, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement and external vendors to align delivery.
Lead without direct authority, setting clear ownership and actions and removing blockers proactively.
Manage a smooth handover from construction to operations/customer, including commissioning, customer acceptance and onboarding.

Continuous Improvement

Capture and apply lessons learned through customer and internal debriefs to improve future deployments.
Contribute to standard processes, templates, tooling and governance within the global Customer Service Delivery organisation.
Mentor and support less experienced Customer Program Managers and contractors where needed.

Qualifications

Essential

8+ years’ experience managing large, complex, customer-facing programmes in data centre, construction, technology or critical infrastructure environments.
Proven ability to work with minimal supervision, exercise sound judgement and own delivery outcomes end to end.
Experience engaging and influencing at executive level with enterprise or hyperscale customers.
Strong understanding of data centre delivery: power, cooling, construction phases, commissioning and colocation or wholesale products.
Commercial awareness, including change control, contract interpretation and milestone-based billing.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive reporting.
Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to run multiple concurrent workstreams.

Desirable

Previous experience in a hyperscale, xScale or cloud campus deployment.
Background working with permitting authorities, utilities or general contractors.
Familiarity with tools such as Smartsheet, Tableau, Salesforce or equivalent platforms.
Formal project management qualification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2/MSP or equivalent).
Experience with order management, book-to-bill processes or service delivery operations.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Mission Operations
jobs.description:
Hubble Network was founded with the intention of delivering on the promise of what Internet-of-Things (IoT) was supposed to be. We're building a global Bluetooth® network dedicated to machine-to-machine connectivity. We differentiate ourselves as the first modem-less and gateway-less, direct-to-satellite network from off-the-shelf Bluetooth® Low Energy chips. Hubble is ideal for applications in logistics, AgTech, and maritime where economies of scale for volume consumer and enterprise asset tracking is a priority. Our goal is to be the first billion-endpoint-connected network in the world.

Hubble is an early-stage, venture-backed startup supported by some of the best investors in the world. In their previous lives, the founding team has been successful in raising $100s of millions in venture funding, developing the Amazon Sidewalk network, launching billions of dollars of space assets, and leading their teams to successful exits, both through acquisition and IPO. We are now looking to bring on talented team members who are the best at what they do to help us make Hubble a reality for the world.

This is a
hybrid full-time
position based in Seattle, WA or San Francisco, CA

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Program Manager, Mission Operations
to own two of the most consequential parts of Hubble's space business: the programs we run through our spacecraft vendors and contract manufacturers, and the day-to-day operation of the constellation those programs deliver.

You will be Hubble's single accountable owner for our spacecraft bus and contract manufacturing partners, running those programs end to end — commercial terms, design reviews, qualification campaigns, hardware delivery, launch integration, and on-orbit commissioning — and holding partners to what they committed to. In parallel you will lead Hubble's Mission Operations function: setting technical direction for how we operate our satellites and payloads, building the team and tooling to scale from a handful of vehicles to a production fleet. It suits someone who has lived on both sides of the table — a strong space program manager with genuine engineering depth, credible in a vendor review and steady in an anomaly call.

This is a full-time, supervisory position reporting directly to our Chief Operating Officer. Seattle, WA is strongly preferred; remote will be considered for the right candidate. Expect regular travel to partner facilities.

AN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS

A Sense of Urgency
: Lead projects from concept to reality, rapidly and effectively
First Principles Engineering
: Have a strong understanding of the whys behind the "what's"; have the ability to extrapolate from first principles to complex system design
High Learning Agility
: Love to learn; have a grounded approach to recognizing your weaknesses and take the initiative to brush up on and sharpen your engineering foundations to better collaborate with your teammates with different backgrounds
System-Level Design and Analysis
: Understand the requirements flow down process and be able to quickly iterate on evolving requirements
Excellent Communication Skills
: Effectively convey ideas and communicate technical topics with engineering, build staff, and operations; run self-directed design reviews and participate in reviews of parallel systems
Anticipation of Needs
: Identify problems, think creatively, and rapidly produce reliable and cost-effective solutions to meet the ever growing and changing needs of an early-stage company

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

10+ years in space or satellite systems, spanning both program management and hands-on engineering or operations.
Demonstrated ownership of a spacecraft, payload, or satellite program through a full lifecycle — design, qualification, delivery, launch, and on-orbit operations.
Proven experience managing external spacecraft vendors, contract manufacturers, or prime/subcontractor relationships with real contract management, schedule execution, and cost accountability.
Engineering depth sufficient to evaluate vendor technical work independently and push back credibly — spacecraft systems, RF communications, or a closely adjacent discipline.
Experience with satellite or payload operations, including telemetry analysis, commanding, anomaly triage, and spacecraft / ground segment interfaces.
Strong program management fundamentals: integrated scheduling, risk management, configuration control, and milestone-driven delivery.
Experience leading structured technical reviews (SRR through ORR) with internal teams and external partners.
Excellent written communication; able to produce concise, decision-oriented material for executives and investors.
Supervisory or team leadership experience, or clear readiness to take it on.
U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (ITAR compliant).

STRONGLY DESIRED

Experience standing up or scaling a mission operations organization.
Familiarity with ground segment service providers, RF chain architecture, front-end processors, and communications security.
Background in small satellite or commercial constellation programs, especially in a production or multi-vehicle context.
Experience with launch services procurement and mission integration.
Exposure to satellite regulatory and licensing processes, and to export control requirements (ITAR/EAR).
Comfort with Jira, Confluence, and software development workflows for requirements and user story management.
Experience in a startup or rapid-iteration environment, and a track record of adding rigor without adding bureaucracy.
Engineering degree in aerospace, electrical, mechanical, or a related field. PMP or equivalent certification is a plus.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

💰 Salary: $145,000 - $235,000 (commensurate with experience, plus equity)

🩺 Comprehensive Benefits – Health, Dental, Vision, & HSA options

📈 Equity – Competitive stock option grant commensurate with experience and level

🌍 Unlimited PTO

🚇 Commuter Benefits (if working from a Hubble Network office)

💪 Health & Wellness Stipend

🌎 Sabbatical Program – Recharge and explore new ideas

🛠 Cutting-Edge Space Tech – Work on state-of-the-art satellite system

The posted compensation range reflects multiple levels within Hubble Network's Talent architecture. Final level placement and corresponding compensation will be determined through the interview and assessment process, taking into consideration factors such as the candidate's relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and geo location!

ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Hubble is required by the U.S. Government to comply with various space technology export regulations including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents ("green card holders") as defined by ITAR (22 CFR

120.15). More information on ITAR can be found here.

Hubble is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Each individual has the right to work in a professional environment that promotes equal employment opportunity and prohibits discriminatory practices, including harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Company

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area

Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management

General Summary

The successful candidate will own technical program management for the Oryon CPU Engineering team’s development and delivery to key Qualcomm SoCs. This is the team behind the Snapdragon X Series and Snapdragon 8 Elite / Gen 5. Work alongside the smartest minds in the industry to deliver best-in-class, efficient, high-performance CPUs.

Responsibilities

Plan, drive, and deliver CPU IP development and integration into silicon products across Qualcomm’s roadmap.
Lead the creation and maintenance of credible and data-driven schedules and project milestones.
Organize and lead interdepartmental meetings to set project milestones/schedules, plans of records, define project tasks, establish program policies and processes.
Responsible for IP-SoC relationship & partnership program management.
Troubleshoot program issues and help to develop alternative program tasks, schedules, milestones, resource plans, processes etc. to resolve program issues and conflicts.
Determine risks, develop mitigation strategies, and communicate information to internal and external key stakeholders. Must be able to proactively drive and solve problems to solutions.
Roll up and report regularly to senior management-executives on key development milestones, budget, metrics, risks, and mitigation plans.
Develop processes to increase the productivity and efficiency of the team.
Manage teams through design, development, validation, test, manufacturing, deployment, and sustaining activities for hardware products.
Be an advocate for the program in cross-functional and stakeholder meetings.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
4+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

MS or PhD degree in Engineering
Experience as an engineer in chip development and integration into hardware or software systems. Experience with silicon development methodologies, leading tape-outs and silicon validation.
A successful candidate requires a strong IP core (preferably CPU) design & debug background including Project Management of IP team working on multiple programs.
Technical domain expertise in all aspects of VLSI development cycle and IP delivery process.
You will help coordinate and support methodology deployment and play a key role in planning future IP validation and development initiatives.
Ability to drive teams towards long-term challenging goals and intermediate milestones, as well as navigating teams through short-term, highly visible priorities.
Track record of successful planning and execution within resource and schedule constraints.
Knowledgeable on program management tools and processes to increase productivity across engineering teams.
Proven skills: communication, negotiation, motivation, dealing and resolving difficult and complex situations, thinking on the fly, and drive to meet the business need.

jobs.description:
Say hello to opportunities.

If you’re looking to be part of what’s next in communication, you’re in the right place.

At RingCentral, we believe the best customer experiences happen when humans and AI work together. Our agentic voice AI portfolio—AIR, AVA, and ACE—brings together automation, assistance, and insights across the entire conversation lifecycle. The result? More seamless, intelligent experiences for businesses everywhere.

With $2.5B+ in ARR and $250M invested in R&D annually, we’re building the future of AI-powered business communications.

This is where you and your skills come in. We’re currently looking for Senior Program Manag
er:

Project & Program Management: Lead strategic initiatives, partner onboarding, and cross-functional projects from planning through execution.
Stakeholder & Partner Management: Build strong relationships with Service Providers and align internal teams to achieve shared business goals.
Operational Excellence: Streamline workflows, manage escalations, resolve issues, and improve post-sales service delivery.

A Day in the Life

This Engineering Program Manager role supports New Product Development (NPD) programs as the Quality Core Team Member (QCTM), serving as the Voice of Quality across design quality, reliability, supplier quality, manufacturing quality, quality systems, software quality, and post-market quality functions. The role is responsible for driving quality and reliability strategy throughout the product lifecycle, influencing product development decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements.

This position is based in Jacksonville, Florida and follows an onsite work model. Travel is expected to be less than 10% and may include visits to suppliers, manufacturing sites, or project-related meetings.

As an Engineering Program Manager
, you will serve as the Quality Core Team Member ( QCTM
) on cross-functional new product development programs, providing strategic leadership for quality, reliability, compliance, and risk management activities. You will partner with engineering, manufacturing, supplier quality, regulatory, and business stakeholders to ensure product quality requirements are defined, implemented, and sustained from concept through commercialization and post-market transition.

Experience with quality systems, design controls, and product lifecycle management processes.

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Design Reliability and Manufacturability (DRM) certification or equivalent experience.
First Time Quality (FTQ) certification.
Experience with medical device product development and software development lifecycle processes.

HDR is looking for a TMT Program Manager
whose experience focuses on client development and delivery of data center projects. The ideal candidate should have a proven background in successfully delivering various data center and mission critical projects ranging from upfront planning and pre-design activities through detail design, construction support and commissioning. This position is an opportunity to join one of the largest, fastest growing, and comprehensive TMT (Tech, Media and Telecom) practices in the industry. In additional to managing and delivery projects (which is the primary focus of this role), the successful candidate must possess the drive, experience and charisma needed to develop and secure work from a robust global client base and expand upon HDR’s reputation within these markets. This individual will manage multi-disciplinary design teams from project conception to completion. Keen focus on organizational skills and follow-through are required to be successful in this role. This person will work closely with the Regional Building Engineering Services (BES) Business Group Managers as well as our global TMT client management team. Some travel to client sites or other HDR offices is required

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary tech media & telecom (TMT) programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of tech media & telecom (TMT) programs, which are all critical to program success.
Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client’s specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution.

Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff.
Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communication.
Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance.
Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program’s financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR’s program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.

Professional Engineering License

CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one (transportation/water/resources) infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million

jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The opportunity

The Enterprise Security Program is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, global information security initiatives across EY. This role is designed for a project leader who can connect strategy to execution, bring together cross-functional teams, and drive outcomes that reduce enterprise risk while supporting business value and operational resilience.

The role requires strong leadership without direct authority, clear executive communication, and the ability to coordinate across Information Security, Member Firms, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, vendors, and other stakeholders.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead complex global information security programs and projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring scope, plans, milestones, risks, budgets and outcomes are actively managed.
Translate enterprise security objectives into clear execution plans that support business value, measurable benefits and risk reduction.
Coordinate cross-functional and geographically distributed teams across Information Security, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, Member Firms, vendors and contractors.
Drive project governance, status reporting, issue escalation and decision-making with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors.
Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, dependencies and RAID items using project management platforms and tools such as MS Project, Azure DevOps or equivalent tools.
Identify risks, issues, interdependencies and resource constraints across programs, busy seasons and organizational priorities, and develop pragmatic mitigation plans.
Facilitate stakeholder alignment by integrating feedback, resolving conflicts and keeping teams focused on shared outcomes.
Support continuous improvement of security processes, governance practices and delivery methods, including lessons learned and sustainable operating models.
Mentor and coach project team members, build team engagement, and encourage accountability, collaboration and quality delivery.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To succeed in this role, you will need to combine information security knowledge, disciplined program delivery, and strong executive presence. The strongest candidates will demonstrate:
Technical and security knowledge: Understanding of information security technologies, including cloud, network, perimeter, messaging, endpoint and data security, along with familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001 and CIS Controls.
Project management depth: Proven ability to manage complex information security projects, including iterative and waterfall delivery methods, planning, budget management, risk management and stakeholder governance.
Leadership without authority: Ability to build trusted relationships, motivate teams, establish a shared vision and drive delivery across teams that do not directly report to the role.
Executive communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify technical matters for non-technical stakeholders and present concise, data-driven updates to senior leadership.
Stakeholder engagement: Ability to engage executive leadership and key stakeholders, understand competing priorities and negotiate alignment at multiple levels of the organization.
Risk and issue management: Ability to anticipate delivery risks, assess business impact, make timely recommendations and drive mitigation through structured plans.
Problem solving: Strong analytical thinking, critical judgment, creativity and conflict-resolution skills in time-sensitive or ambiguous situations.
Global mindset: Comfort operating across cultures, geographies, Member Firms and organizational structures, including awareness of political, regulatory and commercial factors that may affect delivery.

To qualify for the role you must have

Proven experience leading complex global information security, technology or risk-related programs from initiation to closure.
Strong understanding of information security technologies and operating environments, including cloud, network, endpoint, messaging and data security domains.
Experience managing project plans, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, budgets and executive reporting for complex initiatives.
Knowledge of security frameworks, standards and risk management methodologies, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls or comparable frameworks.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors, including preparing clear status updates, recommendations and escalation materials.
Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive outcomes through influence, structure and accountability.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics in business terms.
Experience identifying interdependencies across other programs, operational timelines, business cycles and organizational priorities.
Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Relevant certifications such as PMP, CISSP, CISM or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with project management and delivery platforms such as MS Project, Azure DevOps or similar tools.
Experience supporting compliance, privacy or regulatory requirements, including Privacy Impact Assessments and GDPR-related considerations.
Experience supporting security initiatives that align to business strategy, operational resilience and measurable risk reduction.
Familiarity with vendor and contractor coordination in support of complex technology or security programs.

What We Look For

We are looking for a seasoned Information Security project leader who can bring structure to complexity, communicate with clarity, and deliver outcomes through influence. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with senior leaders, global teams and diverse stakeholders; will be able to connect security priorities to business value; and will lead with accountability, sound judgment and a strong focus on execution. This role requires someone who can remain steady during ambiguity, encourage collaboration during challenges, and keep teams aligned to a shared set of goals.

What
we offer

Job Summary

NetApp’s Cloud business seeks a Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Technical Program Manager to join the Security & Compliance team. This compliance and program management role requires strong cloud technical fluency to prepare products for assessments and certifications, manage risk, translate requirements into testable controls, and improve the security posture. This is not a software engineering role. The position partners with engineering and security teams to automate compliance activities, detection, remediation, evidence collection, and monitoring, including through AI tooling. The role also aligns cross-functional stakeholders and represents the compliance program to leaders, auditors, and hyperscaler partners.

Location: RTP, Boston, Waltham

Design, maintain, and improve compliance programs supporting ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, and FedRAMP assessments and certifications.
Perform technical gap and risk assessments across infrastructure, applications, and cloud engineering processes; monitor controls and advise owners on remediation.
Translate regulatory and compliance controls into clear, measurable engineering and security requirements.
Identify manual compliance activities for automation and partner with engineering and security teams on automated detection, remediation, evidence collection, and continuous monitoring.
Apply AI and related tooling to improve compliance workflows.
Align Engineering, SRE, Product, Cloud Security, Legal, Privacy, and Corporate Security teams and drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.
Partner with Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Amazon Web Services on shared compliance and security objectives.
Manage auditor and assessor relationships and clearly present the organization’s technical security posture.
Improve policies, processes, security governance, and adoption of GRC tooling.

Required Qualifications

6+ years building and managing security risk and compliance programs, including ownership of large cross-functional programs through certification.
Deep knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, and FedRAMP, with demonstrated ability to convert controls into engineering requirements.
Direct experience partnering with engineering teams to deliver technical outcomes.
Exceptional stakeholder management and ability to influence senior stakeholders and external partners without direct authority.
Strong technical fluency in AWS and Azure, Kubernetes, containers, virtual machines, identity and access control, network security, cryptography, logging and monitoring, incident response, DevOps, and CI/CD.
Familiarity with cloud security capabilities, SIEM, vulnerability scanning, cloud security posture management, and endpoint detection and response.
Product-oriented problem solving with the ability to investigate gaps, gather requirements, and drive solutions to completion.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with FedRAMP, GovRAMP, CMMC, CJIS, and NIST 800-53/800-171.
Experience applying AI or large language model tooling to compliance workflows and familiarity with NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Professional certifications in security, compliance, or cloud are advantageous, including CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, CCSP, CIPP, AWS certifications, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor.

Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for Associate Project Manager to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.

Your role in our team

As our new Associate Project Manager, you will play a key role in driving cybersecurity accreditation and compliance initiatives that support critical defense and security frameworks. You will act as the bridge between technical teams, cybersecurity specialists, customers, and key stakeholders, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with stringent security requirements.

In this role, you will translate complex cybersecurity and accreditation requirements into structured project plans, clear milestones, and actionable deliverables. You will oversee the planning, risk management, and delivery of projects aimed at securing defense networks, tactical systems, and infrastructure to achieve official security approvals.

You will be joining an energetic and innovative team within our Cyber & Quantum Technology department. Our team is relatively young, comprising individuals passionate about cybersecurity and technology. We take pride in our dynamic work environment that fosters collaboration, continuous learning as well as professional and personal growth.

How you will make a meaningful contribution

Your key responsibilities include:

Project Lifecycle Management: Define project scope, develop detailed work structures, and maintain integrated schedules to ensure accreditation milestones are met on time and within budget.
Stakeholder & Authority Coordination: Serve as the primary liaison between internal engineering teams, cybersecurity specialists, and the customers.
Accreditation Framework Delivery: Manage and track the preparation, collection, and compliance of security documentation, system descriptions, and artifacts required for formal evaluation.
Risk & Vulnerability Management: Identify, document, and mitigate project risks and technical hurdles that could delay the formal Authorization to Operate (ATO) or security approval.
Reporting & Governance: Conduct regular progress reviews, manage change control processes, and deliver concise status dashboards to senior leadership and clients.

Bring your world class expertise into play

You are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement. Moreover, we are also looking for a new colleague with the following qualifications:

You hold a Bachelor´s degree or a Master´s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

As a person, you are a structured and proactive team player with strong stakeholder management skills. Group Overview

The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

The Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

About Parameta Solutions

Parameta Solutions, the data and analytics division of inter-broker dealer TP ICAP, is a leading global provider of OTC Market Data. From pre to post trade, their solutions help clients manage complex markets more effectively.

In May 2022, the firm became an FCA authorized benchmark administrator. Experience of working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and scope are subject to change

, together with other supporting applications. The scope may evolve as the Quote-to-Order process and application landscape develops. The position is part of the Commercial Excellence – Quote to Order Process
organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.
Act as the primary business process advisor and second-level tool support contact for your region's countries — balancing process discipline with pragmatic tool troubleshooting
Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.
Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries through the change management process.
Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.
Experience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. You are equally confident with business and technical audiences.
Experience working across multiple countries and in matrix organizations; structured, self-driven and ownership-oriented.
Fluent in English; local or regional language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently within your region, particularly during implementation phases.

The Ideal Candidate

You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. You know how to sit with a country team, understand how they work today, and guide them confidently toward a standardized global process, without losing sight of legitimate local needs. You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.

Role Description:

The Cyber Security Assurance, Attack Surface Research (ASR) role maintains and performs queries across a wide array of asset enumeration and research toolsets, spanning on-premises and cloud platforms, to effectively map, measure, and report on the topography of the Bank’s network endpoints and other assets for vulnerability risk.

In addition to core investigative matters, the role is responsible for ensuring the stability and enhancement of the backend infrastructure used to create high quality queries, datasets, and visualizations from various enterprise platforms and security data sources. Individuals in the role will routinely ad-hoc investigate infrastructure and vulnerability asset data in support of partner Information Security teams, to help correctly ascertain and communicate vulnerability risk to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

The role requires a highly collaborative, analytical and detail-oriented mindset, with a focus on ensuring conclusions and/or insights reflect innovative thinking as well as accurate information gathering under time pressure to fully answer three core questions as quickly as possible.

Do we have it?
Are we vulnerable?
Is it exploitable?

Persons in this role operate as part of a team developing methods to quickly reference systems of record (SORs), systems of origin (SOOs) and other available data stores to provide a comprehensive, reliable and timely view of the Bank’s Attack Surface, both as it relates to vulnerability exploitation risk as well as other concerns.

Create SQL and Python scripts within Qualys, Tanium and BladeLogic to query datasets, to support Attack Surface Review.

Develop and maintain visualizations and reports in Power BI or MS-Reporting Services (SSRS) MS-Integration Services (MSIS) that support operational teams, cyber leadership, and stakeholders across Information Security and broader risk teams.

Clearly communicate findings through written analysis and live discussions, including executive level summaries

Deep analytical, problem solving, and conceptual thinking skills
Self-motivated, detail oriented, and able to manage work independently
Amongst others, SQL-backend and Python development experience used for automation, data processing, and integration (as opposed to statistical or ML modeling):
Experience with SQL Server development, including Indexes, constraints, table switching, transaction management, error handling, and activity logging
Experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), including DevOps integration, scripting tasks, packaging, deployment, and conditional workflows
Hands-on experience with data ingestion and ETL pipelines (batch and near real time)
Python development experience used for automation, data processing, and integration
Experience with SSRS, including subscriptions, report management, Tablix, matrix, and cascading parameters
Intermediate to advanced understanding of network infrastructure, including Servers, switches, load balancers, and related components; basic network segmentation and exposure concepts
Excellent research skills with the ability to identify relevant and/or unconventional data sources for enumeration of enterprise technologies, to understand how various assets operate and/or are used across the Bank, as well as persistently investigate and be able to effectively validate findings.

Founded on a legacy of more than 120 years in banking, Bank OZK is much more than just a company. We’re nationally recognized as an industry leader in financial services.
