Learn more about Bank OZK benefits .

Job Purpose & Scope

Responsible for managing the AML Investigations team and overseeing the workstreams responsible for performing AML investigations. Ensures AML investigations are performed timely and that recommended Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) are submitted to FinCEN according to departmental guidelines.

Essential Job Functions

Manages, leads, and mentors AML Investigations Analysts, ensuring they have necessary training and resources to perform their roles effectively.
Ensures AML investigations cases are assigned timely.
Oversees the AML Investigations Analysts to ensure the appropriate disposition is reached on AML investigations cases.
Monitors AML Quality Review (QR) results and provides coaching and feedback to the analysts.
Collaborates with Quality Review (QR) and AML Investigations Lead Analysts to identify analyst coaching opportunities and engages the analysts to ensure optimal performance.
Reviews high-risk customer transactions to identify unusual and potentially suspicious activity.
Reviews completed AML investigations cases and SARs for accuracy and completeness.
Identifies higher risk customers through transaction monitoring and account reviews and refers the customer to AML Operations and Sanctions Director for inclusion on the high-risk customer list.
Recommends the exiting of customer relationships to AML Investigations Director due to suspected illegal, unusual or unauthorized activity.
Assist with 314(b) requests and criminal subpoena process as needed.
Works closely with the Bank’s Fraud Risk Management team to identify criminal and potential criminal activity against the Bank or its customers.
Assists in preparing related documentation for upcoming examinations and audits, as requested.
Assists other teams within BSA Administration and performs other duties, as necessary.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Comprehensive knowledge of investigations and investigative techniques using the Internet, public websites and third-party repositories.
Comprehensive knowledge of BSA/AML laws (including Bank Secrecy Act, USA PATRIOT Act, US Treasury AML guidelines and OFAC requirements).
Knowledge of AML monitoring software and case management systems.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize work projects to meet deadlines.
Ability to utilize discretion and sound judgment in decision making.
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing, including presentation skills.
Ability to manage remote staff effectively.
Ability to travel for business purposes.
Ability to demonstrate initiative and accountability to meet work objectives.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to demonstrate effective organizational, time management and project management skills.
Ability to maintain attention to detail.
Skill in using computer and Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in finance, criminal justice, or a related field, or commensurate work experience, required.
Minimum of four (4) years’ work experience in AML (or comparable field), preferably focusing on SAR investigations.
Minimum of two (2) years’ work experience in a financial institution, required.
Minimum of two (2) years’ experience leading, supervising, or managing others, required.
Professional Certification (CAMS, CFE, CBAP, CRCM) or other related certifications, or willingness to obtain, preferred.

Job Expectations

Operate customary equipment and technology used in a business environment, with or without accommodation.

jobs.description:
Quality, Risk & Information Security Manager

Quality, security and risk management are essential to everything we do. As S[&]T continues to grow within the Space, Defence and High-Tech sectors, we are looking for a Quality, Risk & Information Security Manager to own and continuously improve our integrated Management System.

You will bring together quality management, information security, risk and compliance, ensuring that standards and regulations are translated into practical processes that work across the organisation. Working closely with senior management and technical teams, you will help strengthen our processes, manage risks and prepare S[&]T for continued growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, improving systems and building a strong culture of quality and security.

About the Role

We are looking for a Quality, Risk & Information Security Manager to own and continuously improve our integrated Management System, bringing together quality management, information security, risk and compliance, and working closely with senior management and technical teams to strengthen processes, manage risks and prepare S[&]T for continued growth.

Responsibilities

Own and continuously improve the integrated Management System, including ISO 9001 and ISO 27001.
Coordinate internal, external, customer and certification audits, including follow-up on findings and corrective actions.
Manage risk assessments, non-conformities and improvement activities.
Coordinate information security, cybersecurity governance, GDPR and relevant NIS2 requirements.
Support compliance with customer and Defence-specific requirements, including relevant security frameworks.
Work with IT, HR, Operations and business teams to embed quality, security and risk management into everyday processes.
Report on system performance, risks and improvement opportunities to senior management.

Qualifications

A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.

Required Skills

At least 5 years of relevant experience in Quality Management, QMS/IMS, Information Security, Risk Management or a combination of these areas.
Practical experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001, management systems and audits.
Knowledge of risk management, information security governance and relevant regulations, such as GDPR and NIS2.
A structured, independent and pragmatic approach, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
The ability to turn complex requirements into practical processes and drive continuous improvement.
Essential: Fluent Dutch and English, NATO member country nationality, and the ability to obtain the required NATO security clearance.

Preferred Skills

Nice to have: Experience in Space, Defence, Aerospace or another high-tech environment; knowledge of AQAP and Dutch Defence security requirements (ABDO/ABRO); relevant ISO auditing or information security qualifications.

Why join S[&]T?

Take ownership of an important function within a growing Space, Defence and High-Tech organisation.
Work directly with senior management and technical experts.
Shape and improve how S[&]T manages quality, security and risk.
Enjoy autonomy, varied responsibilities and the opportunity to make a visible impact.

If you enjoy making management systems work in practice, strengthening organisational resilience and helping a technology-driven business grow responsibly, we'd love to hear from you.

Interested?
Then click to apply or send your CV and motivation letter to recruitment@stcorp.nl.

Job Description

Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S) Program Manager (Safety Programs & Compliance)

Are you passionate about building world-class safety programs, driving compliance excellence, and developing meaningful training that helps protect employees every day?

ABM is seeking a Manager, EH&S Safety Programs
to play a key role in shaping and advancing enterprise-wide safety initiatives. This is an opportunity for a safety professional who enjoys combining auditing, program development, regulatory compliance, incident analysis, and employee training to create safer workplaces across a large and dynamic organization.

In this role, you'll partner closely with Safety and Operations leaders to develop practical, compliant, and effective safety programs that reduce risk, improve performance, and strengthen ABM's safety culture. You'll have the opportunity to influence safety strategy across multiple business groups while ensuring programs remain aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

Pay: $85,000 – $95,000.00

The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data. You are eligible to participate in a bonus program.

The exact offer depends on experience, skills, and market data; eligible for an annual bonus.

Benefit Information: ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit

ABM 2026 Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise safety programs.
Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, policies, procedures, training materials, and safety guidance documents.
Monitor federal and state OSHA regulations and assess potential impacts to operations.
Evaluate existing safety programs for regulatory compliance, effectiveness, and alignment with industry best practices, including conducting gap assessments as needed.
Create engaging safety training and educational resources that promote safe work practices and compliance.
Analyze safety performance metrics, audit findings, incident trends, and leading indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.
Review incident investigations, root-cause findings, OSHA investigations, and corrective actions to strengthen safety programs and prevent recurrence.
Conduct and support safety audits, assessments, and program reviews to ensure ongoing compliance and effectiveness.
Partners with Operations and Safety teams to provide practical safety guidance and align safety priorities with business objectives.

What Makes You Successful

Experience in safety program management, regulatory compliance, auditing, or occupational safety leadership.
Strong background developing safety policies, procedures, SOPs, and training programs.
Working knowledge of OSHA regulations and their application in operational environments.
Ability to translate regulatory requirements and industry standards into practical, easy-to-follow safety programs.
Skilled at leveraging audit results, incident data, root-cause analyses, and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Passion for creating programs that go beyond compliance and help build a strong culture of safety.

Qualifications

Attributes Needed

Associate or bachelor's degree in Safety Management, Safety Engineering, Occupational Safety and Health Technology, Industrial Hygiene, Business, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in safety and regulatory compliance.
Experience developing safety policies, procedures, or training materials.
Working knowledge of federal and state OSHA regulations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Above-average proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
Experience with ISO 45001.
Multilingual capabilities.
Experience with Zavanta or other document management software.
Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
OSHA 10 and/or OSHA 30 training.
Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
Up to 10% of local travel, generally 1-2 days per month.
Why Join ABM?
Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on employee safety across a national organization.
High-visibility role partnering with leaders across multiple business groups.
Ability to influence strategic EH&S initiatives, safety standards, and program direction.
Collaborative environment focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Competitive compensation, bonus opportunity, and comprehensive benefits package.

ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience.

ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together.

ABOUT:

GAIN is a creative-led, insight-driven company that blends data, tech and creativity. We believe the best ideas emerge where intelligence and creativity unite, where insight sparks imagination, and where innovation turns possibility into progress.

You'll own client analysis from scope to delivery, working both independently and as part of a wider client team to turn customer data into action. You won't stop at the question, you'll need to look why a result looks the way it does, what's driving it, and what else the data is telling us. You'll bring those insights to life for the client, presenting your work with confidence and authenticity. Present findings and recommendations to clients with confidence, adapting the message to each audience
Act as a senior voice within the wider Customer Science team, sharing best practice and sector knowledge

Accurate and timely delivery of client projects against the scope

Uses data to help guide commercial decisions.

Junior colleagues develop under your mentorship

Experience working with large volumes of customer data and a good general understanding of statistics, measurement, and data modelling
Excellent communication and client presentation skills to a range of stakeholders
Able to run projects from brief to recommendation with minimal oversight

Make It Happen:

"Individually smart. Collectively unstoppable."

Experience in data analytics and interpretation of large volumes of data

The Data Analyst acts as a trusted analytical partner to Springer Nature's China Marketing team, combining analytics, consultancy, and stakeholder collaboration to drive better business outcomes.

Partner with local marketing stakeholders to adapt and extend the marketing KPI and metrics framework, ensuring it stays aligned with local and global business goals, draws on market intelligence about the local competitive and digital landscape, and supports local business needs.

Develop dashboards, reports, and other analytics products, using modern analytics tools and technologies, that enable effective, well-informed decision-making.

Strong SQL skills, including complex querying, data transformation, and data validation.

The Data Analyst transforms complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support decision making across the organisation. Working as part of a matrix team and aligned to a specific functional area (Commercial; or Supply Chain, Procurement & Manufacturing), the role partners closely with business stakeholders to understand their priorities, interpret data in context, and deliver high quality analysis, dashboards, reporting, and presentations. The Data Analyst also supports the respective stakeholder function with projects, tools, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, drive productivity and strengthen data driven decision making, with involvement in and coordination of the optimization of functional processes, tools, and systems.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Functional Business Partnering and Insight Generation
You partner with the supported function to understand business priorities, interpret analytical results, and translate data into meaningful insights that unlock value-creation opportunities, and play an active role in the development and improvement of functional processes, tools, and systems.
You produce accurate, timely monthly management information for the area supported, including analysis, interpretation, and presentation of operational or financial results. In particular, you monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) specific to the function supported and highlight emerging issues or deviations from plan.
You support functional performance cycles such as demand planning, SKU rationalisation or sales pipeline reviews depending on the analyst group.
You provide clear and actionable analysis on trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities relevant to the supported function to support operational and strategic decision-making.
You support the preparation of internal and external presentations(such as vendor or customer meetings), ensuring insights are communicated clearly and effectively.
You act as a trusted analytical advisor within a matrix structure, ensuring strong communication and alignment with both functional leaders and the Business Data Manager.
Data Cleaning, Preparation, Validation & Governance Alignment
You ensure that data pertinent to the function supported is clean and accurate for your function across various sources, such as JDE/ERP, SalesForce, New Horizon, Zycus, Ecovadis and other systems and tools.
You conduct cleaning, validation and preparation of data for operational use and analysis, ensuring accuracy and consistency in line with data governance standards and business guidelines.
You identify data quality issues and escalate them appropriately to the Business Data Manager and Data Architecture and Governance team.
You ensure all reporting uses approved definitions, metrics, and governed datasets.
Subject-Matter Expertise, Dashboards & Visualisation
You act as a subject matter expert in a designated field (e.g. SalesForce, OTIF reports, Zycus) supporting the effective use and evolution of these tools within the function.
You maintain PowerBI and other dashboards, reports, and visualisations that enable stakeholders to easily interpret key metrics and trends.
You run and distribute reports when required and not available in self-serve mode (e.g., performance reviews, monthly business updates, functional meetings), while promoting self‑service where appropriate.
You continuously improve tools and dashboard performance, usability, and clarity.
You suggest and participate in developing improvements to dashboards and reports.
Collaboration, Capability Build and Continuous Improvement
You provide super‑user type support and training to stakeholders on designed tools pertinent to the functional group supported (e.g. SalesForce, Zycus, Ecovadis), Power BI and data‑related activities.
You promote a data-driven culture across Elementis.
Consolidate feedback on new or updated reporting requirements and support the development of these tools and new Power BI dashboards or enhancements.
Collaborate with the Business Data Manager, Technical Specialist, and Data Governance teams to improve data foundations, reporting processes, and analytical capabilities.
Participate in periodic rotation across these expertise areas to broaden capability and organisational resilience.
Functional Projects, Initiatives & Processes
You support functional projects and initiatives by providing analytical input, co-ordination capabilities, and subject-matter expertise that enable better decision‑making, higher growth or more efficient operations.
You coordinate with cross‑functional teams to ensure functional project deliverables are aligned, well‑structured, and supported by accurate data.
You contribute to,and coordinate, improvements and standardisation of functional processes and procedures, automation opportunities, and enhancements to functional performance tools in line with best practice and IT guidelines.
When agreed with the function, you act as the custodian for functional policies and procedures and ensure these updated and stored in relevant repository (e.g. SharePoint, other tools)
You support internal and external audits, and any remediation actions arising from them.

Decision making

You validate business requests relating to data changes before instructing DIG to implement changes ensuring that both functional guidelines and data governance and quality guidelines are met.

You decide how to structure analysis and visualisations to meet business needs.

You make decision on projects, including timelines and milestones.

You resolve day‑to‑day analytical issues to ensure insights are accurate, timely, and aligned with functional expectations.

What will it take

Job Competencies & key personal attributes

Business Partnering & Communication: You work effectively in a matrix, engaging stakeholders across functions and presenting insights and complex concepts in a clear, compelling way. You support your stakeholders making the right decisions.
A dedicated self-starter with high enthusiasm - you need to be self-directed, self-motivated; ability to deal with imperfect information, decision and drive to successful conclusions is paramount in this role.
Drives engagement and influences effectively - it is critical that you are a strong relationship builder and can create a climate where you are able to influence stakeholders over which you have no direct lines of authority.
Analytical Problem‑Solving and “can do” attitude: You interpret complex datasets, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights. You need strong problem-solving and issue resolution aptitude to address the daily situations that an analyst comes across.
Attention to Detail: You ensure accuracy in data updates, data preparation (e.g. pricing change requests), reporting, and other activity management, such as finance reconciliations and variance analysis.
Planning, Project Management & Prioritisation: You manage multiple requests, balancing BAU and ad‑hoc work, and deliver outputs on time.
Team player across functional and data team with uncompromising ethics and unwavering integrity - you need to be a humble, low ego individual who is strong team player, motivated by company goals rather than individual drivers, and with unquestionably integrity.

Technical Knowledge And Skills

Proficiency in Power BI and visualisation best practices.
Excellent Excel skills, including pivot tables, vlookup, advanced functions, graphs. Statistical knowledge is an advantage.
Proven track record of successful partnering with business leadership.
Advanced skills in data collections, cleansing and validation in order to minimize errors and discrepancies.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Knowledge of project management tools.
Familiarity with Python or other analytical tools is an advantage.

3+years work experience including experience in an international manufacturing/industrial environment.
3+ years work experience in an analytical or support role within a function: Sales/Commercial, Supply Chain, Procurement, or Manufacturing.
Demonstrated ability to deliver high‑quality dashboards, reports, and insights.
Experience working cross‑functionally and partnering with business stakeholders.
Experience of having managed projects.

Experience of operating under matrix management is a distinctive advantage.

IT Skills
: Proficient Power BI (required), Proficient or expert level in MS Excel (required); Experience of using project management tools; Python, SQL, SharePoint management (is an advantage but not a must). Language Skills
: Verbal and written fluency in English.

Working arrangements:
The role is full-time and based at the Porto Hub (minimum 3 days per week in the office).

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. We are looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to join our Ads TPM team within the Tech PMO (Technical Program Management Office), supporting the Ads Product & Engineering organization. As a TPM, you will lead your team in driving cross-functional initiatives that span multiple technical teams. In this role, you'll own and drive technical programs in the Ads Monetization engineering space, many of which will require you to work cross-functionally across multiple engineering teams at Reddit. You'll partner with engineering leaders across the company to evaluate prioritization, tradeoffs and risks related to the programs you own.

Who we are:

The Technical Program Management Office
(Tech PMO) exists to accelerate , scale , and empower all teams at Reddit to do their best work and advance our company's mission. We operate from within the office of the CTO, maximizing our ability to galvanize and drive technical programs and solutions to solve company-wide problems. We drive operational excellence within the organizations we partner with and our reach extends across the entire company.

At Reddit, Technical Program Managers
use technical judgment to define and drive large programs across multiple engineering teams. They are a welcome partner to engineering leaders in project discussions impacting planning and execution. They engage with engineering staff in determining root causes, identifying and selecting alternative solutions, and using their technical expertise to understand the effects, impacts, and risks of a solution. Above and beyond program-level impact, they build execution processes and reduce inefficiencies to build overall scale.

High-quality technical program management is a distinct and high-value skillset, and while the roles generally don't involve direct management, they are a part of the organizational leadership. In this role, you will:

Get Things Done
. More than just displaying activity, counting sprint points, or delivering regular updates. You actually bring projects to completion, deliver real accomplishments for the business, and help your teams understand the difference.
Dive into Details
. You understand the details of their projects and help guide them with and in active partnership with their teams. You don't just stay in the stratosphere or in an abstract process. You have the technical judgment to act as a partner with your teams in planning and decision-making.
Make Work Repeatable

Mentor & Lead
. You are good at, and enjoy, informally aiding others in developing key organizational and project skills. You're a leader within your projects and support people in the process.
Bring Order out of Chaos.
You are known for leaving a program and the teams you support in a position of stronger organization than where they started, and those teams continue to succeed even when you are no longer specifically engaged in the project.

8+ years of collective experience in engineering and program management roles, with at least 4 years focused on digital ads platforms or ads monetization.

Technical depth and judgment.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Cleared
new_jobs.description:
About Aalyria

Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.

Role Overview

Aalyria's Spacetime platform orchestrates highly dynamic aerospace networks using a temporospatial Software Defined Networking (SDN) approach, managing not just routing but the physical link topology and lower-layer configuration underneath it.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to own execution on one of our most sensitive customer programs, work that requires an active TS/SCI clearance

, with a polygraph strongly preferred given the access levels involved. You'll be the linchpin between Aalyria's engineering teams and a cleared government customer, driving technical tradeoffs directly rather than simply tracking them. Engineering will look to you to make sequencing, scope, and architecture-adjacent calls, and to represent program status and risk with complete accuracy to customer stakeholders who may not always have full visibility into every technical detail.

This is a role for someone who can operate independently inside a classified environment, hold their own in a room with Staff or Principal engineers, and get things done through influence rather than authority.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technical Program Execution: Own program planning and execution for a classified Spacetime engineering effort, driving the work through each phase of the mission and directly resolving cross-system dependencies and technical tradeoffs, not just surfacing them for others to decide.
Cleared Customer & Stakeholder Leadership: Serve as the primary programmatic interface with a cleared government customer, communicating fluently with both technical staff and senior government stakeholders across classified and unclassified channels.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Run the operating rhythm, such as kickoffs, technical reviews, exec readouts, that keeps Engineering, Product, and Solutions Engineering aligned on status, risk, and decisions across compartmented and uncompartmented workstreams.
Requirements Translation & Technical Judgment: Translate customer and mission requirements into actionable engineering plans. You should be able to read and critique a design document unaided, and reason in real time about latency, throughput, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs.
Security & Compliance Stewardship: Handle classified information and CUI correctly as a matter of course, maintain a sound personal security posture, and follow program security and export-control (ITAR/EAR) requirements without needing to be reminded. Partner closely with the FSO and IT/Cybersecurity, who are direct stakeholders in how this role is evaluated.
Contract & Financial Management: Own T&M or cost-type contract reporting requirements, including monthly labor, subcontract, hardware, and materials tracking at the Master Equipment List (MEL) level to support invoicing.
Risk & Delivery Coordination: Identify schedule, scope, and dependency risk early; escalate with context; and coordinate mitigations directly with engineering leads across development, staging, and dedicated government cloud production environments.

Required Qualifications

Active TS/SCI clearance in good standing. TS/SCI with polygraph is strongly preferred given the access levels this role requires.
5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related role delivering complex technical platforms, ideally for U.S. Government or defense/space customers.
Demonstrated technical depth: the ability to read and critique a design document unaided, and to engage engineering teams on architecture, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs as a peer, not a translator.
A track record with genuinely technical programs, infrastructure migrations, API/interface contracts, cross-system dependency resolution, or multi-team technical rollouts, not just cross-functional coordination with a technical flavor.
Proven ability to influence without authority and interface confidently with senior government and customer stakeholders.
Experience managing complex project financials, resource tracking, or strict contractual reporting requirements (T&M, FFP, or cost-type contracts).
U.S. citizenship (required to hold and maintain the clearance level above).
Background in engineering, hardware/software systems, or solutions architecture, or a related field with hands-on experience running technical programs alongside engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with networking, telecom, or SDN/traffic engineering concepts.
Strong background in satellite and mission operations — early-orbit commissioning, fleet readiness, or operating in high-consequence environments.
Experience supporting programs that have transitioned from prototype to production volumes, and improving TRL/MRL along the way.
In-depth knowledge of USG acquisition processes, FAR/DFARS, and contract vehicles (BAAs, sole-source, IDIQs, OTAs).
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field — preferred, not mandatory. Equivalent hands-on technical experience is evaluated on equal footing.
Willingness to travel occasionally as program needs require.

Compensation

The base salary for this role is $187,000 – $207,000, which may vary by geographic location. Compensation also includes a competitive equity grant, an annual performance bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package. Your final offer will reflect your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

What We Offer

Innovative Environment: Work at a cutting-edge company shaping the future of aerospace communications.
Impactful Work: Directly contribute to critical national security programs and initiatives.
Growth Opportunities: Expand your career with opportunities for professional development and advancement.
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive workplace where your contributions matter.
Flexibility: Flexible working arrangements including hybrid remote/in-office schedules.
Compensation and Equity: Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits (401(k), dental, vision, health, life insurance), paid time off, and equity options.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position involves access to export-controlled information. To comply with U.S. government export regulations, applicants must meet one of the following criteria:

Qualify as a U.S. person, which includes:
U.S. citizen or national
U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder)
Refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157
Asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158
Be eligible to access export-controlled information without requiring an export authorization.
Be eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the necessary export authorization from the appropriate U.S. government agency.

The company reserves the right to decline pursuing an export licensing process for legitimate business-related reasons.

Qualified applicants from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Technical Program Management Team

The Technical Program Management team at Affirm operates at the intersection of strategy, product, and engineering execution. We are versatile operators and trusted strategic partners who drive complex initiatives, design our planning engines, and architect operational frameworks that power the technology behind Affirm's business. Guided by our commitment to putting the customer first and pushing the envelope, we elevate how teams collaborate, resolve critical tradeoffs, and turn high-level vision into scalable reality.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility planning programs for our teams and help streamline our processes for building and delivering great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our business and technology process management practices need to scale with it. In this role, you will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to align efforts with goals, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive change initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible transformation & operational programs in service of our team’s mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives
Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across the company to drive alignment on strategy, priorities, and key decisions.
Implement lean processes and drive towards better ways of working to realize value from planning, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and build a culture of continuous iteration and improvement
Establish and run data-driven operational frameworks to view portfolio performance against OKRs, accelerate value realization by enabling right investment decisions, influence and train teams on more effective ways of working, and create excitement around change to increase adoption
Develop communication strategies to ensure critical information flows seamlessly across the organization
Partner with cross-functional teams to plan change requirements, identify risks, manage dependencies, and establish tools and forums to drive clarity and efficiency
Identify and distill needs, experiment with new ideas to address systemic inefficiencies and bring transparency, visibility, alignment, and promote accountability across the organization

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8 years of proven experience managing programs, processes, and change management in a technology-focused environment
Strong technical background with a deep understanding of software development processes
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to make tradeoff decisions
Strong stakeholder management with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams
Track record of successfully implementing frameworks at scale and building relationships in a remote friendly culture
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and consulting skills
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better

Pay Grade - L

Remote-first with flexibility built in

new_jobs.title: Hyperscale Customer Program Manager 4
new_jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

This is a senior, high-visibility role at the heart of Equinix’s most strategic growth engine. As a Hyperscale Customer Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of large, complex xScale deployments for some of the world’s largest cloud and AI customers, spanning multiple sites, regions and internal teams. You will be the single point of accountability for the customer programme: from contract handover and design, through construction and commissioning, to acceptance, billing and close-out. You will operate with significant autonomy, engage at executive level with customers and internal leadership, and help shape how Equinix delivers at hyperscale.

Responsibilities

Program Delivery & Execution

Lead large-scale, cross-functional, multi-site and cross-regional customer deployments from contract handover through to acceptance and closure.
Own the integrated programme schedule, deployment plans and lifecycle milestones, aligning design, construction, commissioning and ready-for-service dates.
Translate contract commitments (lease terms, technical specifications, delivery dates and SLAs) into a clear, baselined delivery plan.
Track critical-path dependencies such as permits, utility power, long-lead equipment and customer fit-out, and drive mitigation plans.
Identify, manage and mitigate delivery risks and in-flight changes, communicating impact clearly and early to customers and internal stakeholders.

Commercial & Financial Management

Manage the change order process end to end: scope, impact assessment, pricing input, approval and contract alignment.
Track billing and rent commencement milestones so revenue is recognised on time and invoicing is accurate.
Support book-to-bill and backlog reporting with accurate forecast dates and delivery status.
Protect Equinix’s commercial position by ensuring work only proceeds against agreed scope and approved changes.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary customer interface throughout delivery, maintaining an executive-level presence and trusted-advisor relationship.
Run the programme governance rhythm: weekly delivery calls, monthly approval committees and executive reviews covering progress, risks, decisions and milestones.
Produce clear, concise executive reporting, including status dashboards, risk registers, issue notices and close-out documentation.
Build lasting relationships with customer stakeholders across construction, operations, procurement and leadership.

Escalations & Issue Resolution

Independently manage standard and mid-level escalations; partner with senior leadership on complex or contractual issues.
Drive resolution with professionalism and persistence, holding internal teams and vendors accountable for commitments and outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Coordinate across Sales, Legal, Design & Construction, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement and external vendors to align delivery.
Lead without direct authority, setting clear ownership and actions and removing blockers proactively.
Manage a smooth handover from construction to operations/customer, including commissioning, customer acceptance and onboarding.

Continuous Improvement

Capture and apply lessons learned through customer and internal debriefs to improve future deployments.
Contribute to standard processes, templates, tooling and governance within the global Customer Service Delivery organisation.
Mentor and support less experienced Customer Program Managers and contractors where needed.

Qualifications

Essential

8+ years’ experience managing large, complex, customer-facing programmes in data centre, construction, technology or critical infrastructure environments.
Proven ability to work with minimal supervision, exercise sound judgement and own delivery outcomes end to end.
Experience engaging and influencing at executive level with enterprise or hyperscale customers.
Strong understanding of data centre delivery: power, cooling, construction phases, commissioning and colocation or wholesale products.
Commercial awareness, including change control, contract interpretation and milestone-based billing.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive reporting.
Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to run multiple concurrent workstreams.

Desirable

Previous experience in a hyperscale, xScale or cloud campus deployment.
Background working with permitting authorities, utilities or general contractors.
Familiarity with tools such as Smartsheet, Tableau, Salesforce or equivalent platforms.
Formal project management qualification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2/MSP or equivalent).
Experience with order management, book-to-bill processes or service delivery operations.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Mission Operations
new_jobs.description:
Hubble Network was founded with the intention of delivering on the promise of what Internet-of-Things (IoT) was supposed to be. We're building a global Bluetooth® network dedicated to machine-to-machine connectivity. We differentiate ourselves as the first modem-less and gateway-less, direct-to-satellite network from off-the-shelf Bluetooth® Low Energy chips. Hubble is ideal for applications in logistics, AgTech, and maritime where economies of scale for volume consumer and enterprise asset tracking is a priority. Our goal is to be the first billion-endpoint-connected network in the world.

Hubble is an early-stage, venture-backed startup supported by some of the best investors in the world. In their previous lives, the founding team has been successful in raising $100s of millions in venture funding, developing the Amazon Sidewalk network, launching billions of dollars of space assets, and leading their teams to successful exits, both through acquisition and IPO. We are now looking to bring on talented team members who are the best at what they do to help us make Hubble a reality for the world.

This is a
hybrid full-time
position based in Seattle, WA or San Francisco, CA

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Program Manager, Mission Operations
to own two of the most consequential parts of Hubble's space business: the programs we run through our spacecraft vendors and contract manufacturers, and the day-to-day operation of the constellation those programs deliver.

You will be Hubble's single accountable owner for our spacecraft bus and contract manufacturing partners, running those programs end to end — commercial terms, design reviews, qualification campaigns, hardware delivery, launch integration, and on-orbit commissioning — and holding partners to what they committed to. In parallel you will lead Hubble's Mission Operations function: setting technical direction for how we operate our satellites and payloads, building the team and tooling to scale from a handful of vehicles to a production fleet. It suits someone who has lived on both sides of the table — a strong space program manager with genuine engineering depth, credible in a vendor review and steady in an anomaly call.

This is a full-time, supervisory position reporting directly to our Chief Operating Officer. Seattle, WA is strongly preferred; remote will be considered for the right candidate. Expect regular travel to partner facilities.

AN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS

A Sense of Urgency
: Lead projects from concept to reality, rapidly and effectively
First Principles Engineering
: Have a strong understanding of the whys behind the "what's"; have the ability to extrapolate from first principles to complex system design
High Learning Agility
: Love to learn; have a grounded approach to recognizing your weaknesses and take the initiative to brush up on and sharpen your engineering foundations to better collaborate with your teammates with different backgrounds
System-Level Design and Analysis
: Understand the requirements flow down process and be able to quickly iterate on evolving requirements
Excellent Communication Skills
: Effectively convey ideas and communicate technical topics with engineering, build staff, and operations; run self-directed design reviews and participate in reviews of parallel systems
Anticipation of Needs
: Identify problems, think creatively, and rapidly produce reliable and cost-effective solutions to meet the ever growing and changing needs of an early-stage company

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

10+ years in space or satellite systems, spanning both program management and hands-on engineering or operations.
Demonstrated ownership of a spacecraft, payload, or satellite program through a full lifecycle — design, qualification, delivery, launch, and on-orbit operations.
Proven experience managing external spacecraft vendors, contract manufacturers, or prime/subcontractor relationships with real contract management, schedule execution, and cost accountability.
Engineering depth sufficient to evaluate vendor technical work independently and push back credibly — spacecraft systems, RF communications, or a closely adjacent discipline.
Experience with satellite or payload operations, including telemetry analysis, commanding, anomaly triage, and spacecraft / ground segment interfaces.
Strong program management fundamentals: integrated scheduling, risk management, configuration control, and milestone-driven delivery.
Experience leading structured technical reviews (SRR through ORR) with internal teams and external partners.
Excellent written communication; able to produce concise, decision-oriented material for executives and investors.
Supervisory or team leadership experience, or clear readiness to take it on.
U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (ITAR compliant).

STRONGLY DESIRED

Experience standing up or scaling a mission operations organization.
Familiarity with ground segment service providers, RF chain architecture, front-end processors, and communications security.
Background in small satellite or commercial constellation programs, especially in a production or multi-vehicle context.
Experience with launch services procurement and mission integration.
Exposure to satellite regulatory and licensing processes, and to export control requirements (ITAR/EAR).
Comfort with Jira, Confluence, and software development workflows for requirements and user story management.
Experience in a startup or rapid-iteration environment, and a track record of adding rigor without adding bureaucracy.
Engineering degree in aerospace, electrical, mechanical, or a related field. PMP or equivalent certification is a plus.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

💰 Salary: $145,000 - $235,000 (commensurate with experience, plus equity)

🩺 Comprehensive Benefits – Health, Dental, Vision, & HSA options

📈 Equity – Competitive stock option grant commensurate with experience and level

🌍 Unlimited PTO

🚇 Commuter Benefits (if working from a Hubble Network office)

💪 Health & Wellness Stipend

🌎 Sabbatical Program – Recharge and explore new ideas

🛠 Cutting-Edge Space Tech – Work on state-of-the-art satellite system

The posted compensation range reflects multiple levels within Hubble Network's Talent architecture. Final level placement and corresponding compensation will be determined through the interview and assessment process, taking into consideration factors such as the candidate's relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and geo location!

ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Hubble is required by the U.S. Government to comply with various space technology export regulations including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents ("green card holders") as defined by ITAR (22 CFR

120.15). More information on ITAR can be found here.

HDR is looking for a TMT Program Manager

This individual will manage multi-disciplinary design teams from project conception to completion. Keen focus on organizational skills and follow-through are required to be successful in this role. This person will work closely with the Regional Building Engineering Services (BES) Business Group Managers as well as our global TMT client management team. Some travel to client sites or other HDR offices is required

Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of tech media & telecom (TMT) programs, which are all critical to program success.
Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client’s specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution.

Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff.
Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communication.
Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance.
Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program’s financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR’s program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.

Align, communicate, and mentor project managers within the program you are supporting with periodic check-in meetings.
Perform other duties as needed

CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one (transportation/water/resources) infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million
Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)

The Enterprise Security Program is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, global information security initiatives across EY. This role is designed for a project leader who can connect strategy to execution, bring together cross-functional teams, and drive outcomes that reduce enterprise risk while supporting business value and operational resilience.

The role requires strong leadership without direct authority, clear executive communication, and the ability to coordinate across Information Security, Member Firms, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, vendors, and other stakeholders.

Lead complex global information security programs and projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring scope, plans, milestones, risks, budgets and outcomes are actively managed.

Global mindset: Comfort operating across cultures, geographies, Member Firms and organizational structures, including awareness of political, regulatory and commercial factors that may affect delivery.

To qualify for the role you must have

Proven experience leading complex global information security, technology or risk-related programs from initiation to closure.
Strong understanding of information security technologies and operating environments, including cloud, network, endpoint, messaging and data security domains.
Experience managing project plans, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, budgets and executive reporting for complex initiatives.
Knowledge of security frameworks, standards and risk management methodologies, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls or comparable frameworks.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors, including preparing clear status updates, recommendations and escalation materials.
Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive outcomes through influence, structure and accountability.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics in business terms.
Experience identifying interdependencies across other programs, operational timelines, business cycles and organizational priorities.
Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Business Process Manager

We are hiring 3 Implementation Managers to drive our global Quote-to-Order transformation. You will join a key initiative to standardize commercial processes and digital solutions across our business. Apply for the region that matches your profile and career aspirations:

Europe — Flexible location across European countries
America — Flexible location across American countries
Asia — Flexible location across Asia (excl. China)

Each role is autonomous and high-impact, with direct influence on how our commercial operations work in your region.

About The Role

Join ABB Robotics as an Implementation Manager and drive the implementation and adoption of our global Quote-to-Order process and supporting digital solutions.

The role will work closely with country commercial organizations to understand their current ways of working, introduce the global Quote-to-Order process, identify gaps and local requirements, and support countries through the transition to the target process and tools. The current solution landscape includes CPQ and the commercial Quote-to-Order processes interfacing with SAP S/4HANA
, together with other supporting applications. The scope may evolve as the Quote-to-Order process and application landscape develops. The position is part of the Commercial Excellence – Quote to Order Process
organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.
Act as the primary business process advisor and second-level tool support contact for your region's countries — balancing process discipline with pragmatic tool troubleshooting
Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.
Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries through the change management process.
Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.
Experience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. You are equally confident with business and technical audiences.
Experience working across multiple countries and in matrix organizations; structured, self-driven and ownership-oriented.
Fluent in English; local or regional language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently within your region, particularly during implementation phases.

The Ideal Candidate

You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. You know how to sit with a country team, understand how they work today, and guide them confidently toward a standardized global process, without losing sight of legitimate local needs. You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.

Compensation Package

For candidates applying from Italy:

As part of our commitment to transparency, we want to share the compensation details for this position:

Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico

Minimum annual salary: €53.000

Variable Pay: AIP target % + Eligible for Company Productivity Bonus

Country-specific benefits will be discussed with shortlisted candidates based on location.

The offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Benefits As Per Policy

Flexible working hours, hybrid work options, and a strong focus on work-life integration and Wellbeing support for employees and their families

Perform a competitor and pricing analysis.

Chester

Central Park

As part of our commitment to supporting staff travel to and from work in the most sustainable way possible, we also provide tax saver tickets as part of our award-winning benefits package which means getting to work has never been easier

Role Description:

The Cyber Security Assurance, Attack Surface Research (ASR) role maintains and performs queries across a wide array of asset enumeration and research toolsets, spanning on-premises and cloud platforms, to effectively map, measure, and report on the topography of the Bank’s network endpoints and other assets for vulnerability risk.

In addition to core investigative matters, the role is responsible for ensuring the stability and enhancement of the backend infrastructure used to create high quality queries, datasets, and visualizations from various enterprise platforms and security data sources. Individuals in the role will routinely ad-hoc investigate infrastructure and vulnerability asset data in support of partner Information Security teams, to help correctly ascertain and communicate vulnerability risk to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

The role requires a highly collaborative, analytical and detail-oriented mindset, with a focus on ensuring conclusions and/or insights reflect innovative thinking as well as accurate information gathering under time pressure to fully answer three core questions as quickly as possible.

Do we have it?
Are we vulnerable?
Is it exploitable?

Persons in this role operate as part of a team developing methods to quickly reference systems of record (SORs), systems of origin (SOOs) and other available data stores to provide a comprehensive, reliable and timely view of the Bank’s Attack Surface, both as it relates to vulnerability exploitation risk as well as other concerns.

Responsibilities:

Create SQL and Python scripts within Qualys, Tanium and BladeLogic to query datasets, to support Attack Surface Review.
Perform hands-on analysis of large-scale datasets to correlate map, measure, and report on the overall vulnerability attack surface of the Bank.
Leverage Python, SQL, and other languages/platforms to automate data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and quality validation (ETL)
Develop and maintain visualizations and reports in Power BI or MS-Reporting Services (SSRS) MS-Integration Services (MSIS) that support operational teams, cyber leadership, and stakeholders across Information Security and broader risk teams.
Possesses network architecture experience sufficient to reasonably speak to the Bank’s data network and architecture in a timely manner to major inquiries as both an individual and as part of projects by the larger team.
Clearly communicate findings through written analysis and live discussions, including executive level summaries

What we’re looking for:

Deep analytical, problem solving, and conceptual thinking skills
Self-motivated, detail oriented, and able to manage work independently
Amongst others, SQL-backend and Python development experience used for automation, data processing, and integration (as opposed to statistical or ML modeling):
Experience with SQL Server development, including Indexes, constraints, table switching, transaction management, error handling, and activity logging
Experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), including DevOps integration, scripting tasks, packaging, deployment, and conditional workflows
Hands-on experience with data ingestion and ETL pipelines (batch and near real time)
Python development experience used for automation, data processing, and integration
Experience with SSRS, including subscriptions, report management, Tablix, matrix, and cascading parameters
Intermediate to advanced understanding of network infrastructure, including Servers, switches, load balancers, and related components; basic network segmentation and exposure concepts
Excellent research skills with the ability to identify relevant and/or unconventional data sources for enumeration of enterprise technologies, to understand how various assets operate and/or are used across the Bank, as well as persistently investigate and be able to effectively validate findings.

Skills that will help:

Analytical, problem solving, and conceptual thinking skills
Self-motivated, detail oriented, and able to manage work independently
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain and/or translate technical findings in meetings and documentation

Founded on a legacy of more than 120 years in banking, Bank OZK is much more than just a company. We’re nationally recognized as an industry leader in financial services. Learn more about Bank OZK benefits .

Job Purpose & Scope

Responsible for managing the AML Investigations team and overseeing the workstreams responsible for performing AML investigations. Ensures AML investigations are performed timely and that recommended Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) are submitted to FinCEN according to departmental guidelines.

Essential Job Functions

Manages, leads, and mentors AML Investigations Analysts, ensuring they have necessary training and resources to perform their roles effectively.
Ensures AML investigations cases are assigned timely.
Oversees the AML Investigations Analysts to ensure the appropriate disposition is reached on AML investigations cases.
Monitors AML Quality Review (QR) results and provides coaching and feedback to the analysts.
Collaborates with Quality Review (QR) and AML Investigations Lead Analysts to identify analyst coaching opportunities and engages the analysts to ensure optimal performance.
Reviews high-risk customer transactions to identify unusual and potentially suspicious activity.
Reviews completed AML investigations cases and SARs for accuracy and completeness.
Identifies higher risk customers through transaction monitoring and account reviews and refers the customer to AML Operations and Sanctions Director for inclusion on the high-risk customer list.
Recommends the exiting of customer relationships to AML Investigations Director due to suspected illegal, unusual or unauthorized activity.
Assist with 314(b) requests and criminal subpoena process as needed.
Works closely with the Bank’s Fraud Risk Management team to identify criminal and potential criminal activity against the Bank or its customers.
Assists in preparing related documentation for upcoming examinations and audits, as requested.
Assists other teams within BSA Administration and performs other duties, as necessary.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Comprehensive knowledge of investigations and investigative techniques using the Internet, public websites and third-party repositories.
Comprehensive knowledge of BSA/AML laws (including Bank Secrecy Act, USA PATRIOT Act, US Treasury AML guidelines and OFAC requirements).
Knowledge of AML monitoring software and case management systems.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize work projects to meet deadlines.
Ability to utilize discretion and sound judgment in decision making.
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing, including presentation skills.
Ability to manage remote staff effectively.
Ability to travel for business purposes.
Ability to demonstrate initiative and accountability to meet work objectives.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to demonstrate effective organizational, time management and project management skills.
Ability to maintain attention to detail.
Skill in using computer and Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in finance, criminal justice, or a related field, or commensurate work experience, required.
Minimum of four (4) years’ work experience in AML (or comparable field), preferably focusing on SAR investigations.
Minimum of two (2) years’ work experience in a financial institution, required.
Minimum of two (2) years’ experience leading, supervising, or managing others, required.
Professional Certification (CAMS, CFE, CBAP, CRCM) or other related certifications, or willingness to obtain, preferred.

Job Expectations

Operate customary equipment and technology used in a business environment, with or without accommodation.

Quality, Risk & Information Security Manager

Quality, security and risk management are essential to everything we do. As S[&]T continues to grow within the Space, Defence and High-Tech sectors, we are looking for a Quality, Risk & Information Security Manager to own and continuously improve our integrated Management System.

You will bring together quality management, information security, risk and compliance, ensuring that standards and regulations are translated into practical processes that work across the organisation. Working closely with senior management and technical teams, you will help strengthen our processes, manage risks and prepare S[&]T for continued growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, improving systems and building a strong culture of quality and security.

About the Role

We are looking for a Quality, Risk & Information Security Manager to own and continuously improve our integrated Management System, bringing together quality management, information security, risk and compliance, and working closely with senior management and technical teams to strengthen processes, manage risks and prepare S[&]T for continued growth.

Responsibilities

Own and continuously improve the integrated Management System, including ISO 9001 and ISO 27001.
Coordinate internal, external, customer and certification audits, including follow-up on findings and corrective actions.
Manage risk assessments, non-conformities and improvement activities.
Coordinate information security, cybersecurity governance, GDPR and relevant NIS2 requirements.
Support compliance with customer and Defence-specific requirements, including relevant security frameworks.
Work with IT, HR, Operations and business teams to embed quality, security and risk management into everyday processes.
Report on system performance, risks and improvement opportunities to senior management.

Qualifications

A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.

Required Skills

At least 5 years of relevant experience in Quality Management, QMS/IMS, Information Security, Risk Management or a combination of these areas.
Practical experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001, management systems and audits.
Knowledge of risk management, information security governance and relevant regulations, such as GDPR and NIS2.
A structured, independent and pragmatic approach, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
The ability to turn complex requirements into practical processes and drive continuous improvement.
Essential: Fluent Dutch and English, NATO member country nationality, and the ability to obtain the required NATO security clearance.

Preferred Skills

Nice to have: Experience in Space, Defence, Aerospace or another high-tech environment; knowledge of AQAP and Dutch Defence security requirements (ABDO/ABRO); relevant ISO auditing or information security qualifications.

Why join S[&]T?

Take ownership of an important function within a growing Space, Defence and High-Tech organisation.
Work directly with senior management and technical experts.
Shape and improve how S[&]T manages quality, security and risk.
Enjoy autonomy, varied responsibilities and the opportunity to make a visible impact.

If you enjoy making management systems work in practice, strengthening organisational resilience and helping a technology-driven business grow responsibly, we'd love to hear from you.

Interested?
Then click to apply or send your CV and motivation letter to recruitment@stcorp.nl.

Are you passionate about building world-class safety programs, driving compliance excellence, and developing meaningful training that helps protect employees every day?

ABM is seeking a Manager, EH&S Safety Programs
to play a key role in shaping and advancing enterprise-wide safety initiatives. This is an opportunity for a safety professional who enjoys combining auditing, program development, regulatory compliance, incident analysis, and employee training to create safer workplaces across a large and dynamic organization.

In this role, you'll partner closely with Safety and Operations leaders to develop practical, compliant, and effective safety programs that reduce risk, improve performance, and strengthen ABM's safety culture. You'll have the opportunity to influence safety strategy across multiple business groups while ensuring programs remain aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

Pay: $85,000 – $95,000.00

The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data. You are eligible to participate in a bonus program.

The exact offer depends on experience, skills, and market data; eligible for an annual bonus.

Benefit Information: ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit

ABM 2026 Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise safety programs.
Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, policies, procedures, training materials, and safety guidance documents.
Monitor federal and state OSHA regulations and assess potential impacts to operations.
Evaluate existing safety programs for regulatory compliance, effectiveness, and alignment with industry best practices, including conducting gap assessments as needed.
Create engaging safety training and educational resources that promote safe work practices and compliance.
Analyze safety performance metrics, audit findings, incident trends, and leading indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.
Review incident investigations, root-cause findings, OSHA investigations, and corrective actions to strengthen safety programs and prevent recurrence.
Conduct and support safety audits, assessments, and program reviews to ensure ongoing compliance and effectiveness.
Partners with Operations and Safety teams to provide practical safety guidance and align safety priorities with business objectives.

Experience in safety program management, regulatory compliance, auditing, or occupational safety leadership.
Strong background developing safety policies, procedures, SOPs, and training programs.
Working knowledge of OSHA regulations and their application in operational environments.
Ability to translate regulatory requirements and industry standards into practical, easy-to-follow safety programs.
Skilled at leveraging audit results, incident data, root-cause analyses, and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Passion for creating programs that go beyond compliance and help build a strong culture of safety.

Qualifications

Associate or bachelor's degree in Safety Management, Safety Engineering, Occupational Safety and Health Technology, Industrial Hygiene, Business, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in safety and regulatory compliance.
Experience developing safety policies, procedures, or training materials.
Working knowledge of federal and state OSHA regulations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Above-average proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
Experience with ISO 45001.
Multilingual capabilities.
Experience with Zavanta or other document management software.
Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
OSHA 10 and/or OSHA 30 training.
Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
Up to 10% of local travel, generally 1-2 days per month.
Why Join ABM?
Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on employee safety across a national organization.
High-visibility role partnering with leaders across multiple business groups.
Ability to influence strategic EH&S initiatives, safety standards, and program direction.
Collaborative environment focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Competitive compensation, bonus opportunity, and comprehensive benefits package.

ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience.

ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together.
